dog.description_text: Flapjack is serving up a delicious combination of sweetness, charm, and pure kitten fun. This young kitty with his beautiful silky black coat and gentle personality, is the whole package and the best way to start the day! Flapjack is wonderful with other cats, loves a good rub, and has a special talent for running right into your arms when he sees you. He is playful and curious when it is time for kitten fun, then perfectly happy to settle in for some affection when the zoomies are over. He has all the wonderful qualities you could hope for in a cat and plenty of personality to make him extra special. Breakfast may be the most important meal of the day, but Flapjack might just be the sweetest part of yours.
